security_audit.summary: The review found no prompt injection, malicious network behavior, credential access, or reconnaissance intent in the skill files. content.value_statement: Marketing teams need consistent plans, messages, templates, and measurement across many channels. This skill provides campaign workflows, channel guidance, tracking utilities, and reporting frameworks.
actual_capabilities: Guides campaign briefs, audience research, channel strategy, launch timelines, and post-campaign reviews.
Provides templates for email, landing pages, paid ads, social posts, campaign briefs, and case studies.
Explains social media, email, paid advertising, content marketing, and brand consistency practices.
Defines KPIs, attribution models, reporting dashboards, and data quality checks for campaign measurement.
Includes a Python utility for generating UTM parameters, validating tracking URLs, and exporting CSV tracking sheets.
limitations: It does not connect to ad platforms, email tools, CRMs, or analytics systems automatically.
Campaign recommendations depend on current audience, budget, brand, product, and performance data supplied by the user.
The utility script writes local CSV files only when the user runs it with file paths.
Regulated industries still need legal, privacy, and brand review before publishing campaign assets.

use_cases.title: Plan a Product Launch
use_cases.description: Create a launch brief with audience segments, messaging pillars, channel mix, timeline, and success metrics.

use_cases.title: Build Multi-Channel Content
use_cases.description: Draft coordinated email, social, landing page, and ad concepts from one campaign strategy.

use_cases.title: Measure Campaign Performance
use_cases.description: Define KPIs, tracking links, attribution approach, dashboard sections, and post-campaign recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Campaign Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a campaign brief for [product or offer]. Include objective, audience, message, channels, timeline, budget notes, and KPIs.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Channel-Specific Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this campaign brief into email copy, three social posts, one landing page outline, and two paid ad concepts.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Tracking Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a UTM and KPI tracking plan for this campaign. Include naming rules, dashboard sections, and reporting cadence.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Live Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these campaign results and recommend optimizations. Compare channels, diagnose weak conversion points, and propose next tests.

output_examples.input: Plan a lead generation campaign for a B2B analytics product.
output: A campaign brief with target personas, pain points, offer, channel strategy, timeline, budget assumptions, and launch checklist.
A content plan covering LinkedIn posts, email nurture, landing page sections, and paid search messaging.
A measurement plan with leads, conversion rate, cost per lead, pipeline contribution, and reporting cadence.

output_examples.input: Create a tracking plan for a product launch across email and paid social.
output: UTM naming guidance for source, medium, campaign, and content variants.
Recommended dashboard sections for traffic, engagement, leads, cost, and revenue influence.
A post-launch review structure for wins, missed targets, lessons, and next tests.

output_examples.input: Improve email performance after low open rates.
output: Subject line test ideas, send-time checks, segmentation recommendations, and deliverability review points.
A revised nurture sequence outline with clearer audience value and stronger calls to action.

best_practices: Provide brand voice, target audience, offer details, budget, and timeline before asking for campaign outputs.
Use the analytics guidance before launch so KPIs and tracking links match the campaign goals.
Review generated copy for legal, privacy, brand, and platform policy requirements before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not use generic campaign prompts without a target audience, objective, offer, or channel context.
Do not publish generated ads, emails, or landing pages without human review and factual verification.
Do not treat the sample URLs, sample metrics, or template placeholders as production-ready data.

faq.question: Can this skill publish posts or send emails?
faq.answer: No. It helps plan and draft campaign materials. Users must publish through their approved marketing tools.

faq.question: Does it require marketing platform credentials?
faq.answer: No credentials are required. The included script works with local input and output files only.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What should I customize first?
faq.answer: Start with brand voice, audience segments, product messaging, campaign goals, approved channels, and current KPI targets.

faq.question: Does it include analytics guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes KPI frameworks, attribution guidance, reporting templates, dashboard ideas, and UTM tracking support.

faq.question: Can it replace compliance review?
faq.answer: No. Legal, privacy, brand, and platform policy reviews remain necessary before campaign launch.
